These fixtures are copies of the synthetic telemetry examples published by
the simple-coding-agent repository. That repository owns the telemetry
snapshot contract (schema v1); this dashboard only reads it.

Source repository: https://github.com/lbacik/simple-coding-agent
Source path: examples/telemetry/
Source commit: 58401c44753765813e47cd2367e79373ba81c437
  ("Publish telemetry snapshot contract v1 with synthetic examples",
   merged as PR #248 for "Make agent containers discoverable and publish
   telemetry snapshot examples")
Seen at: 69b15f1d9bf87639d1942a27c594996f269f38e8 (main)

The files are synthetic: invented repositories (example-owner/...),
invented attempt ids, and example.invalid URLs. No data was captured from
live instances.

Copies:
- snapshot-idle-with-last-finished.json — idle agent, last finished attempt
- snapshot-attempt-in-progress.json — attempt in progress, partly estimated
- snapshot-soft-threshold-handoff.json — soft threshold crossed, handoff
- snapshot-recovery-hold.json — recovery hold with next action
- snapshot-truncated.json — trimmed snapshot, truncated: true
- error-agent-unreachable.json — code agent_unreachable
- error-unsupported-operation.json — code unsupported_operation
- error-snapshot-failed.json — code snapshot_failed

These fixtures are copies of the synthetic agentctl command-reply
examples published by the simple-coding-agent repository. That
repository owns the command-reply contract; this dashboard only reads
it. Contract: docs/agents/agentctl-command-replies.md.

Source repository: https://github.com/lbacik/simple-coding-agent
Source path: examples/agentctl/
Source commit: 6abe94c8db3435afe6967808c38722569b583d16
  ("Publish mutating agentctl command replies as a test-pinned contract",
   merged as PR #321 for "Publish the agentctl command reply contract")
Seen at: 4c8039f0f42878273febdd1ec61a4528e8cad843 (main)

The files are synthetic: invented repositories (example-owner/...),
fixed request IDs (req-example-...), and {{SOCKET}} for the control
socket the conformance test substitutes (not-submitted.json pins the
missing socket path it was recorded with). No data was captured from
live instances.

Copies:
- accepted.json — stop accepted (active attempt finishes first)
- completed.json — stop completed (no active attempt)
- rejected.json — stop --after rejected by a stopped instance, with the repository: line
- not-submitted.json — connection loss: exit 2, no reply, no repository: line
- usage-error.json — argparse usage error: exit 2, usage: prefix on stderr
- command-found.json — command <id> for a recorded command
- command-not-found.json — command <id> for an unknown ID, with the repository: line
